social.author: @saintkeith@mstdn.social
social.text: Recently went to an excellent talk by Brett Pawlak, DP from Spider-Man: Brand New Day. One unexpected takeaway was that Marvel Studios requires a plate shot of each scene after nearly every set up. This is so they don't have to revisit locations / rebuild sets if they need a pickup during editing. Just film actors in front of a green / blue screen, put the original scene behind them in post, and cut it into the original sequence. Brilliant. # filmmaking # cinematography # spiderman # marvel
